questions.question: Several figures (per-pass findings from each pass's hand-back line, active time by the gap method, the session splits and the round-to-submission mapping) are not produced by tokkit report/subagents alone. How should the record name their derivation?

options.label: Commit a small script (Recommended)
options.description: Add sdd/research/token-usage/deliveries.py that runs tokkit's parser over the snapshots with the session splits as arguments and writes an ID-free results/deliveries_bk389_bk394.json with provenance. Every figure cites a field, as report.md does. Adds ~200 lines of research code to review.

options.label: Kit commands + stated method
options.description: The record cites the kit commands per session and states the hand-composition (sums, splits, the hand-back count line, the gap rule) in prose. Nothing new committed besides the record; figures are reproducible only by redoing the steps.

questions.question: ROADMAP says BK-431 (the reviewer-agent input) is kept or dropped by this step. Evidence: every one of the ~75 review passes ran as `reviewer` with a 19.5k-21.6k first context, against run B's 42.9k-43.9k. What should this PR do with BK-431?

options.label: Record evidence only (Recommended)
options.description: The record reports the evidence and says it supports keeping; BK-431 stays [~] and you close it (trace, BACKLOG-DONE, the ADR-0036 staffing-clause supersession) in a later step. Keeps this PR to research + ROADMAP + memory.

options.label: Close BK-431 as kept here
options.description: Also move BK-431 to BACKLOG-DONE with its trace and record the partial supersession of ADR-0036's staffing clause. Wider PR, touches process files and the budget.

options.label: Recommend dropping
options.description: Record says the evidence does not justify keeping; BK-431 stays [~] for your call.
